    • transform

      public final void transform(processing.core.PVector pVector)
      applies this matrix to a vector ( M * v ). the x axis of the matrix is the image of ( 1, 0, 0 ), and a.multiply(b) followed by a.transform(v) applies b first, then a.
      Parameters:
      pVector - vector to transform

    • transformInverse

      public final void transformInverse(processing.core.PVector pVector)
      applies the inverse of this matrix to a vector without changing the matrix. a singular matrix has no inverse and leaves the vector unchanged.
      Parameters:
      pVector - vector to transform
